description: A painting at dusk: a thick white smoke plume rises from a small chimney on a low classical building at left. A large domed basilica with a lit facade and statues fills the right side. In the foreground a dense crowd of silhouetted people raises arms and waves flags, mostly American stars-and-stripes, plus yellow-and-white and other flags. Warm orange sky, dark clouds, painterly brushwork, edge to edge with no frame.
